description: Registry of all canonical PoliSnap structural templates. Each entry maps a templateId to its template file. The polisnap-generator skill checks this catalog before constructing a snap — if a match is found, the template is used as the structural scaffold.

lookupStrategy.primary: explicitTemplateId — check NORM file for 'templateId' field
lookupStrategy.secondary: signatureHash — compute by joining NORM's suggestedElements[] with '|' separator in order; compare against each entry's signatureHash
lookupStrategy.tertiary: snapCategory + contentType — fuzzy match by category and first element type
lookupStrategy.onNoMatch: AUTO_GENERATE — derive a new template from the snap being constructed, save to templates/, register here

templates.description: Daily congressional floor vote with For/Against speaker debate, vote tally bar, policy summary, sentiment pulse, and provenance footer.
Single-representative position or vote snap anchored to one named senator or representative. Includes floor statement quote, bill vote badge, context summary, sentiment poll, and provenance footer.

autoGenerationRules.deriveTemplateIdFrom: First element type + contentType inferred from NORM metadata. Example: NORM with Header.Bill → 'bill-{contentSlug}'
autoGenerationRules.registrationRequired: YES — any auto-generated template MUST be registered in this catalog before the snap is written
autoGenerationRules.approvalNote: Auto-generated template creation MUST be included in the Step 4 approval summary presented to the user. The template file is written as part of the approved file batch.
